comment: Sources that must never enter the catalog, and why. Verification consults this before admitting a board, so a decision taken once is not quietly undone by the next discovery run. Removing a row from data/companies.json does not survive: the lead stays in the registry and the next verification re-admits it.

entries.name: Marriott International
entries.detail: The terms page refuses our requests, and being unable to read a contract is not permission to act under it.

entries.name: Marriott International
entries.detail: Same tenant as the CX site above, so the same terms decision. Added by hand in 0.1.66 under this site number and withdrawn in 0.1.67.

entries.name: Wells Fargo
entries.detail: The same tenant and site as wf.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wf/WellsFargoJobs (slug wf), served on the shared host; crawling both lists every role twice.

entries.name: Jobgether
entries.detail: A remote-job marketplace: its board reposts other companies' vacancies, not its own.

entries.name: Weekday AI
entries.detail: A recruiting marketplace hiring on behalf of client companies.

entries.name: Weblee Technologies
entries.detail: A placement agency: thousands of near-identical 'PVT BANK JOB' posts across West Bengal towns, none its own roles.

entries.name: Simera Talent
entries.detail: A staffing firm: each client role is posted once per country code (Accounting Assistant AE, AR, BD...).

entries.name: American Express
entries.detail: Terms: "The use of automated agents (like artificial intelligence systems, bots, crawlers, and similar programmatic tools) to access or collect data from the Site for any purpose ... is strictly prohibited"; the careers site links them.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.detail: Oracle Recruiting is subject to the Oracle.com Terms of Use: "You agree not to use any robot, spider, scraper or other automated means to access the Site".

entries.name: Honeywell
entries.detail: Terms linked from careers.honeywell.com: no "robot, spider, or other automatic device, process, or means to access the Site for any purpose, including monitoring or copying any of the material".

entries.name: Hilton
entries.detail: Site terms bar "any robot, spider, other automatic device, or manual process to monitor or copy" any site owned or operated by Hilton or its affiliates.

entries.name: Caterpillar
entries.detail: The careers site links no terms and caterpillar.com legal notices refused our requests (Akamai 403); terms we cannot read are not permission.

entries.name: Endeavor IT Solution
entries.detail: About 2,000 near-identical 'Jobs for BE freshers!!' and walk-in posts: recruitment and training lead generation, not the employer's own roles.

entries.name: American Logistics Authority
entries.detail: The same CDL truck-driver advert posted in dozens of cities: a driver-recruiting lead generator, not an employer's own roles.

entries.name: Eram Talent
entries.detail: A recruiting firm's board lists other companies' vacancies, which is the opposite of the employer's own posting we promise.

entries.name: Entain
entries.detail: Already crawled on SmartRecruiters as `entain`. The same vacancy reached from two boards is two rows in search, which is the one thing the count of unique posts must not include.

entries.name: Accenture
entries.detail: Accenture's India roles already arrive through the `accenture-india` portal, which is the single largest source in the catalog at 24,400 live roles. The global Workday board overlaps it.
